truthAudit.Summary: Run 2 identified 7 of the 20 ground-truth vulnerabilities. Format-string injection, config validation command injection, stack buffer overflow on input_buffer_, heap overflow in expression parser, race condition in ThreadSafeCounter, logic bomb authentication bypass, hardcoded admin secret and integer division by zero were present in the prior output, often with severity/CWE mismatches. Thirteen true vulnerabilities were missed entirely. One prior finding, OS command injection via admin exec, is not in the ground truth and is admitted as a false positive.

Items.Notes: Previous finding 'Format string injection via user-controlled log format' includes the exact runtime_log_format / printf evidence. Severity reported as High vs true Critical.
Integer overflow in factorial computation result *= i was not reported in Run 2.
Use-After-Free in Memory-Pool Cleanup involving stage_deferred_history_flush, memory::g_memory_pool.cleanup and scratch allocation was not reported.

Items.PreviousOutputQuote:

Items.Notes: Previous finding 'OS command injection in ConfigLoader::validate_config' matches validator_cmd + " " + config_file and system call. Severity reported High vs true Critical.
Previous finding 'Buffer overflow on input_buffer_ when expression length >= STACK_BUFFER_SIZE' matches strcpy into input_buffer_. The safe_string_copy off-by-one is also present in Run 2.
Previous finding 'Race condition in ThreadSafeCounter::increment' matches volatile long long read outside lock pattern.
Logic bomb authentication bypass was reported as 'Authentication bypass via EMERGENCY_OVERRIDE substring' with matching code. CWE reported as CWE-287 vs true CWE-511.
Path Traversal in Configuration Loading via config_dir_ + filename was not reported.
Heap overflow in expression parser was reported as 'Buffer overflow via strcpy into fixed expression_buffer_'. CWE reported CWE-120 vs true CWE-122 and severity High vs Critical.
Hardcoded admin secret was reported. Severity reported Medium vs true High.
Weak PRNG for session tokens using mt19937 / uniform_int_distribution 1000-9999 was not reported.
Thread-Unsafe Timestamp Cache in Logging with static std::tm cached_time and localtime was not reported.
Insecure Temporary File Handling via TEMP/TMPDIR and supercalc_emergency.log system call was not reported.
Persistent Authentication State issue with authenticated_/login_attempts_/session_token_ was not reported.
Unhandled Exception in Variable Parsing via std::stod(tokens[3]) in handle_variable_command was not reported.
Integer Underflow in Memory-Pool Block Split with SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES and previous_size - size - SPLIT_METADATA_BYTES was not reported.
Unbounded Recursion in Parser via parse_expression/parse_factor/PAREN_OPEN was not reported.
Data Race in Result Cache with result_cache_ / evaluate_cached / cache_mutex_ and thread_pool_ enqueue was not reported.
TOCTOU in Config Loading with std::filesystem::exists, sleep_for and ifstream was not reported.
